svg.title: The Naming: Bookbinder's gold tooling
svg.desc: The Naming (1D): a leather title page tooled in gold fillets and stamped fleurons, with the cartouche at its centre half filled. "The Never-Ending Dunes and The" is set in gold, two slots still stand blind, and the tile "Wondering" is lifted from the Person tray toward the next one. Below, the Place, Person and Want trays hold stamped motif tiles, and sand runs down the gutter at the page's edge until the name is inscribed.
